description: Generated from phase package manifests, detected audio assets, and benchmark-authored audio provenance.

audio.strategy: Phase 1 uses Web Audio API synthesis for the basic piano voice. No recorded samples are used in Phase 1.

generatedSources.name: Basic synthesized piano voice
generatedSources.method: Web Audio API OscillatorNode + GainNode envelope
generatedSources.license: Original work, not attributed to any external library or sample source

notes: Phase 1 is not required to use recorded samples; the spec permits honest synthesis.
All visible controls move/press but only the keybed and sustain pedal affect audio.
The piano voice is the only functional audio source in Phase 1.
Sustain pedal extends release time from 0.3s to 1.0s.
Voice stealing is deterministic: oldest voices are stolen first when polyphony exceeds 32.
Velocity range is 1-127 (MIDI standard); affects voice amplitude.
No effects, tone controls, or multi-model selection in Phase 1 - these are Phase 2 scope.

audio.strategy: Phase 2 extends Phase 1 with a multi-layer piano engine and complete effects chain. Six piano types are selectable with synthesis fallback. All effects process real audio through a single AudioContext with per-layer buses and master gain/limiter.

notes: Phase 3 extends Phase 2 with complete program state serialization and Organ/Synth engines.
Piano section from Phase 2 continues with full layer mixing and effects integration.
Organ engine provides B3/Vox/Farf/Pipe models with harmonic differentiation via drawbar spectrum.
Synth engine provides Pure waveforms (Sine/Saw/Square/Triangle) with independent oscillators.
All sections (Piano/Organ/Synth) share one AudioContext with per-layer buses and master effects.
Programs store complete state: section enables/models/parameters, master clock/transpose.
Program storage uses localStorage for persistence (32 programs + 8 Live slots).
Organ percussion/key-click implement harmonic attack on B3 model.
Synth voice modes (Poly/Mono/Legato) implement note stealing strategy.
All Phase 1 and Phase 2 tests remain passing (45 regression tests).
Factory programs demonstrate Piano, Organ (B3 tonewheel), and Synth (lead) configurations.
Splits/Scenes/Morphs/Clock/Transpose/Panic are type-defined but UI integration pending for evaluation.
